events.title: Peace of Westphalia Signed
events.description: The Treaties of Osnabrück and Münster were signed, ending the Thirty Years' War in the Holy Roman Empire and the Eighty Years' War between Spain and the Dutch Republic.
events.significance: The settlement established principles of state sovereignty and territorial integrity that became foundational to the modern international system of nation-states.

events.title: First Transcontinental Telegraph Completed
events.description: The Pacific Telegraph line connecting Omaha, Nebraska, with Sacramento, California, was completed, linking the eastern United States with the West Coast by telegraph.
events.significance: It allowed near-instant communication across North America and made the Pony Express obsolete within days.

events.title: Black Thursday Stock Market Crash
events.description: Panic selling hit the New York Stock Exchange as a record volume of shares was traded and prices plunged, beginning the collapse of the market.
events.significance: Black Thursday was the start of the 1929 crash, which preceded the Great Depression and reshaped global economic policy and financial regulation.

events.title: United Nations Charter Comes into Force
events.description: After ratification by China, France, the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom, the United States, and a majority of other signatories, the UN Charter took effect, officially founding the United Nations.
events.significance: The UN became the central international organization for peacekeeping, diplomacy, and cooperation, and October 24 is observed annually as United Nations Day.

events.title: Ethiopian-born Hope? No: Sony Betamax Introduced in the US? Correction: Pioneer of Mass Home Video
events.description: Sony's Betamax videocassette recorder went on sale in the United States in 1975, bringing home video recording to consumers, though specific launch dates varied by market.
events.significance: Betamax helped start the home video revolution and the format war with VHS, changing how people consumed television and film.
